title: B1 pin covers the data stage only — ok=false propagation through load_font_file/load_fonts and the three os.exit(2) refusals have no automated test
evidence: font_test.odin:64-67: "Pinned at the DATA stage (font_atlas_build — pure CPU; the GPU texture upload is the caller's and cannot fail for the committed assets). The exit itself is the callers' thin" / line 70-78: "font_guard_reports_missing_asset :: proc(t: ^testing.T) { ... _, _, ok2 := font_atlas_build_from_file(\"assets/fonts/definitely-missing.ttf\"); testing.expect(t, !ok2, ...) _, _, ok3 := font_atlas_build_from_file(\"data/palette.json\")" — the test never calls load_font_file (view.odin:1461-1469 "load_font_file :: proc(asset: string) -> (rl.Font, bool) { ... return f, rl.IsFontValid(f) }") nor load_fonts (1477); harness tests are 2 a11y-oracle pins only (grep @(test) harness/*.odin); tools/ has no missing-asset exit test (grep 'font-check|missing-asset|exit 2' tools/ .github/ → no hits)
